payload.title: Current Gate - 2026-08-03 Stopped Pilot and Candidate Audit
facts: The user explicitly paused pilot `9655921`; the hash-bound `STOP_USER_REQUESTED` gate allowed only `STOP_JOB`, the sole executor issued the stop, and current LSF evidence is `EXIT`.

Pilot `9655921` completed zero ionic steps. Image09 exhausted `NELM=200` with repeated BRMIX and runaway electronic energies; empty CONTCAR files prevent post-run force or geometry interpretation, and `nebmovie.pl 1` therefore failed.

Prior one-step pilot `9640399` completed all eight images electronically at 52--58/200 steps with final total moments `105.0202--107.0277 muB`; its C-O coordinate is monotonic, but the later 203-step production path proved underresolved between images05/06.

Prior one-step pilot `9647154` completed all ten images electronically with moments `105.2394--107.2532 muB` and monotonic C-O; it is geometrically smoother but has high first-step forces and uses the older full-product endpoint.

The current-local-endpoint pilot `9650404` is the exact one-step case with image05 at `NELM=200`, but its magnetization falls from about `106.53` to `93.08`, `95.94`, then `81.85 muB`; it is not a magnetically continuous reusable path.
Pilot `9654860` also completed one step with four images at `NELM=200`, but its total moments span `56.71--106.32 muB`; it is rejected as the requested stable magnetic branch.
payload.next_action: Keep all VASP work paused and obtain the user's choice between adapting the smoother old ten-image geometry as a seed or rebuilding a current-endpoint path from the magnetically stable eight-image branch; neither old path is directly production-ready.
